At zero detuning, $\delta=0$, the effective detuning $\Delta_0$ vanishes.  In this
resonant limit we write
\begin{equation}
R = \Delta_0 \qquad \Delta_0 \equiv 0 .\label{resonant}
\end{equation}
Away from resonance, $\delta\ne0$, the same effective detuning $\Delta_0$ is nonzero.
The following (deliberately erroneous) continuation is sometimes written:
\begin{equation}
\Delta_0 = 0 .\label{off-resonant}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
